## Duty drawback FAQ

### Are Section 301 duties eligible for duty drawback?

Yes. CBP's published position, stated in CSMS #18-000419 and its Section 301 FAQ, is that Section 301 duties are eligible for drawback under 19 U.S.C. 1313, refundable up to 99 percent when the goods are exported or used in qualifying manufacturing. Claims must report both the Chapter 99 line and the underlying HTS code in the same order as the import entry.

### Is Section 232 drawback-eligible in 2026? That means any eligible 301-duty-paid imports from 2019–2020 may already be outside the claim window unless you’ve already filed or preserved your rights.

# CBP Confirms Section 301 Tariffs Are Drawback Eligible

 August 19, 2026
 J.M. Rodgers Team

Importers paying the new Section 301 duties should not assume that these additional tariff costs are unrecoverable.
